title: The Hand Song
text:
We sing a song about hands. We clap our hands. Then we stand up.

Next we jump like frogs. Everybody laughs and sings again. The song is short and fun.

questions.text: What do we do with our hands in the song?
How do we move in the second part of the song?
How do the children probably feel during the song?
Who is most likely singing this song?

vocabulary.definition: to hit your hands together to make a sound
to be on your feet, not sitting or lying down
to push your body up into the air using your legs
small animals with long back legs that live near water

paragraph_translations: Śpiewamy piosenkę o rękach. Klaszczemy w ręce. Potem wstajemy.
Potem skaczemy jak żaby. Wszyscy się śmieją i znowu śpiewają. Piosenka jest krótka i zabawna.
